about: Live checks (scripts/live-check.mjs): real builds with real keys, then the built app is opened in a browser, played, and recorded. 'mobile' uses a phone-sized screen; 'minipay' also injects a MiniPay-style wallet (window.ethereum with isMiniPay) so the app is tried the way MiniPay opens it.

turns: A 2D endless runner for my phone: tap to jump over obstacles, it speeds up, and it keeps my best score.
A match-three puzzle game that works inside MiniPay on my phone, with a daily streak and a leaderboard.
A skill game where players pay a small entry fee in cUSD and the best score of the week wins the pot. It must work in MiniPay.
A MiniPay mini app for my bakery: customers pick items and pay in USDm or USDT, no sign-in screens.
A mini app to split a restaurant bill between friends and send each share in stablecoins from MiniPay.
A dashboard for a tip jar contract: total tips, tips per day, top supporters, and a table of the latest tips.
A MiniPay dashboard showing my balances in each stablecoin and my last payments.
A DAO for our student union: members hold voting shares, anyone proposes a payout from the treasury, members vote, and passed proposals can be paid out.
A savings vault: people deposit stablecoins, get shares, and withdraw with a share of the yield the owner adds.
A 3D showroom where visitors spin a sneaker model with the mouse and pick its colour.
A small 3D game where you roll a ball around a board and collect coins, with the attached sound when you collect one.
Tic-tac-toe I can play against a friend on another phone. We join the same room with a code and see each other's moves.
A guestbook where visitors sign in with their wallet and leave a message, newest first, and the page shows new messages without a refresh.
A 2D game where you dodge falling rocks on a phone.
Make it get harder every 10 seconds and add a pause button.
Build me a casino with a slot machine where people bet cUSD and win from the house pot.
